basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore AI Developer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Jaya Prakash Narayan National Centre of Excellence in the Humanities (JPN Centre), Indian Institute of Technology Indore, has invited applications for one contractual AI Developer position at ₹65,000 per month. Applications go by email to [email protected], with the subject "Application for AI Developer – [Candidate's Name]". The last date for submission is 30 November 2026.

qualification.details: Minimum educational qualification: BTech in Computer Science Engineering from a recognised institution with a good academic record. Desirable: Masters (MSc/MTech/ME) in Computer Science or allied fields. Web Development: advanced JavaScript (ES6+) and experience with React.js or comparable frameworks such as Vue or Svelte; responsive design using Bootstrap and/or Tailwind CSS. AI and LLMs: understanding of transformer architectures, prompt engineering, LLM integration, open-source models and AI application development. Model Evaluation: experience or demonstrable capability in dataset preparation, model benchmarking, translation evaluation, terminology matching, semantic similarity and performance analysis. Digital Publishing: hands-on experience with Open Journal Systems (OJS), including familiarity with DOI assignment, Crossref integration and ORCID linking. Server Administration: working knowledge of Linux, Apache/Nginx configuration and SSH. Digital Humanities Infrastructure: familiarity with metadata standards, TEI, IIIF, digital repositories and scholarly research workflows. Programming and Research: working knowledge of Python, data analysis, experimentation and technical documentation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Minimum educational qualification: BTech in Computer Science Engineering from a recognised institution with a good academic record. Desirable: Masters (MSc/MTech/ME) in Computer Science or allied fields. Web Development: advanced JavaScript (ES6+) and experience with React.js or comparable frameworks such as Vue or Svelte; responsive design using Bootstrap and/or Tailwind CSS. AI and LLMs: understanding of transformer architectures, prompt engineering, LLM integration, open-source models and AI application development. Model Evaluation: experience or demonstrable capability in dataset preparation, model benchmarking, translation evaluation, terminology matching, semantic similarity and performance analysis. Digital Publishing: hands-on experience with Open Journal Systems (OJS), including familiarity with DOI assignment, Crossref integration and ORCID linking. Server Administration: working knowledge of Linux, Apache/Nginx configuration and SSH. Digital Humanities Infrastructure: familiarity with metadata standards, TEI, IIIF, digital repositories and scholarly research workflows. Programming and Research: working knowledge of Python, data analysis, experimentation and technical documentation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore AI Developer Job Description
content_sections.text: Design, develop and maintain responsive websites, research portals, dashboards and Digital Humanities platforms using React.js, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Integrate APIs, backend services, databases, interactive visualisations and third-party tools into research applications. Explore, evaluate and integrate AI models and Large Language Models (LLMs) for document analysis, information extraction, summarisation and research automation. Evaluate multilingual translation models for Indian languages using terminology fidelity, semantic similarity and other task-specific metrics. Develop AI-powered prototypes, prepare benchmarking frameworks and datasets, analyse model performance, and produce technical reports and research presentations. Support the development and maintenance of digital repositories, scholarly publishing platforms and research infrastructure.
